result.description: Cloud CRM platform for sales, service, marketing and custom apps, with extensive APIs over standard and custom objects.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 via an External Client App (connected app creation restricted since Spring '26): web server/auth-code+PKCE, user-agent, device, refresh token, client credentials, JWT bearer. SOAP API also accepts username+password login for a session ID. Flow list from search results and Trailhead, not page-verified.
result.access_detail: Free Developer Edition org at developer.salesforce.com/signup gives working API credentials, with API Enabled on by default. Customer orgs need an edition with API access (Enterprise and up, or an add-on) and an admin to authorize or install the external client app. Hosted MCP servers need Flex Credits and Enterprise Edition or above.
result.api_notes: REST API covers CRUD, SOQL/SOSL, composite and describe over all standard and custom objects. Also SOAP, Bulk API 2.0, Metadata, Tooling, GraphQL, Connect REST and Pub/Sub (gRPC) APIs. Docs fetch returned 403 here, so breadth is from search snippets and prior knowledge.

evidence.quote: If you already have a Developer Edition organization, verify that your user profile has the API Enabled permission.
Using a separate org to develop your applications protects your live data during testing.
Salesforce CLI is a connected app that you can authenticate, and it requires no work to configure.
Salesforce provides a set of standard MCP servers that expose built-in platform and product capabilities, pre-configured with a fixed set of tools.
